pages.text: Most TFMG machines never stop without a reason, and they tell you the reason. You have two ways to ask.

$(l)Engineer's Goggles$()$(br)Look at the machine. Under its tanks and progress, a $(item)red line$() names what stops it. The next pages list every one of these lines, what it means and how to fix it.$(br2)$(l)Factory Inspector$()

Right-click a machine with the $(item)Factory Inspector$() for a full report: what is in place (green), what blocks the machine (red) and what to do about it (gold). Right-click the air instead for a $(item)progression checklist$(): how far you are along the mod's production chain and what the next step needs.
$(l)Also check$()$(li)The $(item)JEI info pages$(): look up a machine in JEI to read how it is built and fed.$(li)The chapters of this handbook, to compare with what you built.
One general line exists for every machine with an output tank: $(item)Output tank full: pump the result out$(). Pipe the product away and the machine resumes by itself.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
